product.title: Pisicuța fermecată. Aventuri la școală
product.description: Abi tocmai și-a ocupat camera în căminul școlii cu internat la care va învăța de acum încolo, când Keera, o colegă mai mare, îi cere cu aroganță să se mute. Nu e o primire prea plăcută…iar gesturile răutăcioase nu se opresc aici. Fetița are însă norocul să-l întâlnească pe Flame, pisoiul fermecat, care o ajută să-i dea Keerei o lecție. Dar cum se va descurca Abi după plecarea lui?

# The Charming Kitten: Adventures at School Book Series

Immerse your young reader in a magical new adventure with *The Charming Kitten: Adventures at School*. This captivating story from Litera follows Abi as she navigates the challenges of boarding school life and discovers that sometimes, even the smallest friend can teach the biggest lessons. Perfect for readers who love friendship, mystery, and coming-of-age tales.

## Meet Abi and Her New Life

Abi has just found her new room in the boarding school dormâa fresh start for her education. However, this seemingly exciting transition comes with immediate conflict. She quickly encounters Keera, a senior student who displays blatant arrogance and demands that Abi leave her assigned space. The initial welcome is far from delightful, setting the stage for a series of mean-spirited incidents throughout the week.

## A Magical Friend Arrives

Just when things reach their peak of frustration, Abi experiences a stroke of luck: she meets Flame, a charming kitten. Flame quickly becomes more than just a pet; he acts as a catalyst for change. With his playful help and clever insights, Flame aids Abi in teaching Keera an important lesson about kindness and respect.

The central mystery revolves around this journey: How will Abi manage and thrive in her new environment after the magical presence of Flame eventually departs? This book promises delightful tension, heartwarming friendships, and a strong message about standing up for what is right.

This middle-grade fiction title is ideal for encouraging critical thinking alongside enjoyment. It tackles relatable themes such as making new friends, dealing with conflict in a group setting, and finding confidence when facing bullies. The blend of everyday school life with magical elements makes it an engaging read for both reluctant and avid readers alike.
